items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: I got that gig with him just for a little while.

ctx.x: But then you both got into the rhythm & blues scene. And I’m trying to get a sense of the guys you played with: Big Maybelle and so forth. Those were current pop artists at the time, in those years, right.

Yeah, the Philadelphia based artists, I mean, most of them they were all out of Philadelphia: Lin Holt and he played saxophone, and actually Trane played with Lin Holt. And that was great. I got that gig with him just for a little while. And Dick Hart and the Heartaches, I played with that band.
